Executable projection of [53-swissknife-visual-functional-mcplusplus.md](53-swissknife-visual-functional-mcplusplus.md). Machine task contracts: `config/swissknife_visual_functional_tasks.json`.

The canonical JSON/DuckDB import is the initial plan snapshot. This Markdown board is the single runtime status authority. Preserve SVD/SWR/VDG/VDL/VOG boards and foreign working-tree changes. One browser task and one leased writer run at a time.
